entries.title: Bloemgracht: the townsman, the farmer and the sailor
entries.reason: 87-91 are listed: check no monument draft covers them
entries.hook: Three identical gables, three stones: not trades but three ways of living in the Golden Age.

entries.title: Marnixstraat 291-293, houses on the old bastion below the street
entries.hook: Houses already on the 1625 map sit below street level, with bastion stones along their sunken lane.

entries.title: Het Gangenproject, the Willemsstraat's vanished alleys in the pavement
entries.hook: Tiles mark the 57 slum alleys of the filled Goudsbloemgracht; the Jordaanmuseum fought nine years to lay them.

entries.title: Vaste klant, a statue paid for a bar tab
entries.hook: A young artist settled his café tab with a statue of a sad regular stroking the cat.

entries.title: Energie en tijd, Verhulst on the substation
entries.hook: A 1962 concrete-and-steel relief on the biggest substation of its day, where the English gasworks stood.

entries.title: Theo Thijssen Museum
entries.hook: The writer's birth house, rebuilt in its old form after a fuss, with a small museum of the 1890 Jordaan.

entries.title: Lindengracht, the filled canal and the eel riot
entries.hook: Police stopped an eel-pulling game here in 1886; the riot that followed left 26 dead.

entries.title: The anonymous sculptor of the Anjeliersstraat
entries.reason: how many remain needs a walk
entries.hook: Small iron figures appear on Jordaan walls overnight; the maker stays anonymous, rumour once said Queen Beatrix.

entries.title: Kees de jongen on the "Tuinpleintje"
entries.hook: Theo Thijssen's schoolboy painted on a Tuinstraat wall in 2025, paid by residents' vote; pupils sang at the unveiling.

entries.title: Bevrijdingslinde van Jordaankinderen
entries.reason: pin approximate; urn under the tree unconfirmed
entries.hook: A lime paid by pupils of thirteen schools in 1946 for war-dead Jordaan children; neighbours saved it twice.

entries.title: Noordermarkt: what the locals point at
entries.reason: Noorderkerk draft (jordaan-3) already has the Jordaanoproer statue as a Look for line: keep the church story there
entries.hook: The stolen strike plaque found in an alley, a dune-water tap post, and markets that fought "vertrutting".

entries.title: Johnny Jordaanplein, the people's statue garden
entries.reason: well known to Amsterdammers: pitch the self-management
entries.hook: Busts of Jordaan singers on a square the council never named; a self-appointed keeper nailed up the sign.

entries.title: Eerste Marnixplantsoen, the bastion in the grass and the 1966 riot
entries.hook: The Singelgracht's only bastion still pointed; the 1966 builders' riot began at the patronaat at no. 1.

entries.title: Noorderspeeltuin on the Carthusian graveyard
entries.reason: burial is "vermoedelijk"; Karthuizerhof draft names the graveyard
entries.hook: The Jordaan's oldest club (1908), pointed-roof huts and majorettes on the graveyard where Jan Klaassen may lie.

entries.title: Nassaubioscoop, the Moorish front on the Lijnbaansgracht
entries.hook: A 1913 cinema's three horseshoe arches, behind netting for years; the Jordaanmuseum wanted it and lost.

entries.title: Perlee, the street organ workshop
entries.hook: Street organs rented "with a monkey" since 1875; at Westerstraat 119 since 1932, still making organ books.

enrich.draft: Turnzaal of 1887, the gym hall with Rust Roest on its front
enrich.add: war story: Jews barred from clubs 1941; Jan 1945 Arbeitseinsatz registration office here and the resistance attempt to blow it up on 8 Jan 1945

enrich.draft: Concordia on the Westerstraat, Peace be to this house
enrich.add: the two inner bleaching courts behind Westerstraat 221-289 and 327-405, summer hofjes concerts
tante Mie's floating pay toilet under the bridge and the skipping rhyme; BW-36: the rattle watch's room in the arch (door in the arch)

enrich.draft: Tweede Laurierdwarsstraat, what the clearances left standing
enrich.add: the two Weespad gardens kept by neighbours (rock garden, grapes, hofjes concerts) and the 2009-10 fight against an extension

enrich.draft: The lost fruit market's last blocks, Marnixstraat 200–220
enrich.add: local voice: residents' seven-year fight against demolition, "Gallisch dorp" street party 6 June 2008

enrich.draft: The London Police on Prinsengracht 70, the mural the neighbours kept
enrich.add: Look for: the dense small street art in the Tuinstraat and Egelantiersstraat

enrich.draft: Raepenhofje and Bossche Hofje, two hofjes bought on one day
enrich.add: add access: open by day, gate locked at night
the passages under it, told with both versions

enrich.draft: Rozenhofje, an almshouse on an old pleasure maze
enrich.add: add access: open only on Open Monumentendag
local voice: 2007 thesis by Frans Thuijs ("Jaco was geen Amsterdammer"), reader's "De Jordaan is dus een mythe kwijt"

enrich.draft: Pianola Museum in police station no. 21
enrich.add: local voice: 2009 neighbour "Ik wist helemaal niet dat hier een muziekgebouw zat!"
